input.description: Add a simulation scenario. Include `scenarioParameters` for key user-tunable assumptions (reference them in expressions as `scenario.<identifier>`). `parameterOverrides` keys MUST be existing net-level parameter IDs; omit the field entirely when nothing is overridden. `initialState.content` keys are place IDs when `type` is `per_place`, but place NAMES when `type` is `code` (note the asymmetry). Never author `initialState.type` `adhoc` — that variant belongs to the in-app form; use `per_place` or `code`.
